data.title: All Seasons - Damac Hills
data.about:
Want to live the convertible life? Then move to All Seasons at Damac Hills. Apartments with personal terraces including convertible walls and roof. Choose from studios and 1 – 3 bedroom apartments overlooking the golf course and park. 

These homes are amazingly designed with the most beautiful aesthetics and is spacious. The amenities are incomparable and endless. Move into your golf course terraced home today!

characteristics_module.title: Terraces with Convertible Walls and Roof
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Ready terrace apartments in Damac Hill
  • Choose from studios, 1, 2, 3 BR apartments
  • Starting at AED 560K
  • Pay over 5 years
  • Every apartment has covered terrace (20% of sellable area)
  • Views of the golf course or the park

location_tile.title: Close To Everything
location_tile.description:
All Seasons is nestled within the gated golf course community of Damac Hills.

  • Dubai Polo & Equestrian Club – 10 minutes
  • Dubai Autodrome – 12 minutes
  • The Plantation Equestrian and Polo Club – 11 minutes
  • Miracle Garden – 13 minutes
  • Dubai International Stadium – 14 minutes
  • Global Village – 14 minutes
  • IMG World – 14 minutes
  • Hamdan Sports Complex – 15 minutes
